data.title: 空门苍 · 幽夜古林与七影蝶之引
data.description: 鸟白岛后山幽深的神社古木深处，成百上千只泛着幽蓝荧光的“七影蝶”在空中盘旋。身着巫女服的苍手执提灯静静走过古树根，神情专注而庄严。
data.location: mystical nocturnal forest clearing surrounded by giant mossy roots and glowing blue spirit butterflies
data.action: walking through ancient forest path holding a warm paper lantern, watching glowing butterflies flutter around her, serene spiritual expression
data.lighting: 手中提灯暖光与漫天幽蓝七影蝶荧光
data.promptProse: Ao walks along a mossy forest trail in traditional miko robes holding a glowing lantern as luminous blue butterflies swirl around her.
data.animaCaption: Ethereal blue butterfly lights swirl past her lantern as she navigates the sacred night forest. Her lantern and the butterflies illuminate her face and the mossy roots.
